name: codex-image-grid-native
description: Native-first Rust + SwiftUI Codex Image Grid plugin source. It will provide Prompt Batch image generation through a locally owned Rust runtime and SwiftUI app, using local reference-image paths for native and MCP callers. During development, do not silently fall back to the frozen Electron implementation.

interface.shortDescription: Native Rust + SwiftUI Prompt Batch image-grid runtime
interface.longDescription: Native-first replacement source for Codex Image Grid. The final plugin will expose generate_image_grid through MCP, launch or verify the Rust local runtime, pass native and MCP reference images by local path, and return the same job status, manifest, handoff, image paths, and Codex Markdown contract as the frozen Electron baseline. The web/browser route is compatibility-only; native runtime failures must be reported instead of silently falling back to the old implementation.
defaultPrompt: Generate a Prompt Batch image grid with the native Image Grid runtime
Use the native Rust and SwiftUI Image Grid app for this project
Verify the native Image Grid runtime and MCP connection
